adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair recovered Table 3 antimicrobial/toxicity rows and Table 4 salt MIC rows, reconciled linked database rows while preserving figure-only and aggregate database conflicts, and replaced automated mechanism placeholders with locator-backed mechanism claims. No blocking rework target remains; caution findings are explicit.
summary: T9W is supported as a P. aeruginosa-targeted synthetic RI16 derivative with low-µM MIC/MBC values against P. aeruginosa strains, no Table 3 cytotoxicity below >256 µM, retained activity under tested physiological salts, and direct membrane-perturbation evidence. Database conflicts remain cautionary where exact antibiofilm percentages or aggregate labels exceed local tabular support.

CAMP/dbAMP aggregate text mixes source-supported Table 3 MICs with broader labels or LC/anticancer text not recoverable as exact source table values.
